review_method: agent source review; canon and precise reveal timing unverified

characters.name: Kiritsugu Emiya
characters.description: A pragmatic mage entering the Grail War for the Einzberns. He fears its consequences for Irisviel.

characters.name: Irisviel von Einzbern
characters.description: Kiritsugu’s wife, who supports their shared ideals despite the danger of the coming war.

characters.name: Kirei Kotomine
characters.description: A priest selected for the Grail War. He studies magecraft under Tokiomi.

characters.name: Tokiomi Tohsaka
characters.description: A Grail War participant who arranges to train Kirei as his pupil.

characters.name: Kariya Matou
characters.description: Returns to the Matou family to seek Sakura’s release, accepting painful magical training to enter the war.

characters.name: Sakura
characters.description: A child adopted into the Matou family. Kariya wants to free her from its treatment.

characters.name: Zouken Matou
characters.description: Kariya’s father, who agrees to release Sakura if Kariya obtains the Grail.

characters.name: Waver Velvet
characters.description: A student who believes effort can overcome magical pedigree. He steals a catalyst to prove himself in the war.

characters.name: Kayneth El-Melloi Archibald
characters.description: Waver’s teacher, who dismisses his ideas about effort and inherited magical ability.

characters.name: Saber
characters.description: The Servant summoned by Kiritsugu. Her appearance surprises him and Irisviel.

characters.name: Rider
characters.description: Waver’s independently minded Servant, fascinated by the modern world and intent on conquest.

characters.name: Ryuunosuke Uryuu
characters.description: A murderer whose attempted demon summoning instead brings forth Caster.

characters.name: Caster
characters.description: Ryuunosuke’s Servant, who shares his enthusiasm for cruelty.

characters.name: Assassin
characters.description: Kirei’s Servant, sent to infiltrate Tokiomi’s residence.

characters.name: Archer
characters.description: Tokiomi’s Servant, who attacks the intruding Assassin.

characters.name: Maiya Hisau
characters.description: Kiritsugu’s assistant, who brings weapons and intelligence to support his preparations.

characters.name: Lancer
characters.description: A Servant who challenges Saber to a duel at the harbor.

characters.name: Berserker
characters.description: Kariya’s heavily armored Servant, who clashes with Archer and attacks Saber.

characters.name: Sola-Ui
characters.description: Kayneth’s fiancée, who supplies Lancer with magical energy.

characters.name: Rin Tohsaka
characters.description: A student mage determined to win the Grail War. She summons Archer and revives a wounded classmate.

characters.name: Archer
characters.description: Rin’s Servant, who reports that he cannot recall his identity and fights Lancer.

characters.name: Shirou Emiya
characters.description: A student who witnesses a Servant battle and is revived by Rin after Lancer wounds him.

characters.name: Lancer
characters.description: A Servant who attacks the student who witnessed his fight with Archer.

characters.name: Shirou Emiya
characters.description: A helpful student inspired by Kiritsugu’s ideals of justice. Under attack at home, he unknowingly summons Saber.

characters.name: Sakura
characters.description: Shirou’s friend, who shares breakfast with him and Taiga.

characters.name: Taiga
characters.description: Shirou’s legal guardian, who shares his household routine.

characters.name: Issei
characters.description: A schoolmate who appreciates Shirou’s help but warns that others may exploit it.

characters.name: Kiritsugu Emiya
characters.description: Rescued Shirou during a devastating fire. His ideals inspire Shirou’s ambition.

characters.name: Saber
characters.description: A Servant summoned by Shirou who drives off Lancer.

characters.name: Kirei Kotomine
characters.description: The war’s overseer and Rin’s legal guardian. He explains the conflict to Shirou.

characters.name: Illyasviel von Einzbern
characters.description: Introduces herself during the confrontation and directs Berserker against Shirou’s group.

characters.name: Berserker
characters.description: Illyasviel’s Servant, whose overwhelming strength and regeneration withstand the group’s attacks.

characters.name: Shirou Emiya
characters.description: An inexperienced Master sheltering Saber at home. He agrees not to demand her hidden identity.

characters.name: Saber
characters.description: Shirou’s Servant, who explains why combatants conceal their identities and stays at his home.

characters.name: Rider
characters.description: A Servant who attacks Shirou during the school incident and is driven away by Rin.

characters.name: Shirou Emiya
characters.description: A student who helps others using modest magic. He wants to carry on his late adoptive father’s ideal of justice.

characters.name: Kiritsugu Emiya
characters.description: Shirou’s late adoptive father, whose ideals and magical teaching shaped him.

characters.name: Taiga Fujimura
characters.description: Shirou’s legal guardian, who looks after him at home.

characters.name: Sakura Matou
characters.description: Shirou’s classmate, who helps Taiga care for him.

characters.name: Rin Tohsaka
characters.description: A student mage preparing for the Grail War by summoning Archer.

characters.name: Archer
characters.description: The Servant summoned by Rin for the coming conflict.

characters.name: Shinji Matou
characters.description: Sakura’s older brother, whose recent aggression attracts attention at school.

characters.name: Lancer
characters.description: A Servant who fights Archer and attacks Shirou for witnessing the duel.

characters.name: Saber
characters.description: A Servant accidentally summoned when Shirou faces another attack at home.

characters.name: Kirei Kotomine
characters.description: The Fifth War’s overseer and Rin’s legal guardian, who explains the war to Shirou.

characters.name: Illyasviel von Einzbern
characters.description: A young Master who introduces herself and directs Berserker in battle.

characters.name: Berserker
characters.description: Illyasviel’s powerful Servant, who severely wounds Saber.

characters.name: Rider
characters.description: A Servant who attacks at school and nearly kills Shirou before Rin intervenes.

episodes.title: Apocrypha: The Great Holy Grail War

characters.name: Kairi Sisigou
characters.description: A mage recruited to the Red side of the war, who summons Mordred.

characters.name: Rocco Belfeban
characters.description: A Clock Tower official who briefs and recruits Sisigou.

characters.name: Darnic
characters.description: Leader of the opposing Yggdmillennia group, preparing golems for the coming conflict.

characters.name: Avicebron
characters.description: A Servant assisting Darnic with golem production.

characters.name: Mordred
characters.description: The Servant summoned by Sisigou using a Round Table catalyst.

characters.name: Jeanne d’Arc
characters.description: The Ruler-class Servant tasked with overseeing the war impartially.

characters.name: Astolfo
characters.description: A Servant fighting for the Black faction.

characters.name: Siegfried
characters.description: A Servant fighting for the Black faction.

characters.name: Shiro Kotomine
characters.description: A priest leading the Red faction, whose plans draw Sisigou’s distrust.

characters.name: Semiramis
characters.description: Shiro’s Servant, involved in preparations for the Red faction.

characters.name: Karna
characters.description: A Servant ordered by Shiro to attack Jeanne.

characters.name: Gordes
characters.description: A Black-faction mage who accompanies Siegfried and tries to recruit Jeanne to his side.

characters.name: Chiron
characters.description: A Black-faction Servant who treats an escaped homunculus.

characters.name: Escaped homunculus
characters.description: A newly awakened being seeking freedom from the castle. Astolfo brings him to Chiron for treatment.

characters.name: Fiore
characters.description: A Black-faction mage who hopes the Grail can heal her legs without costing her magic.

characters.name: Caules
characters.description: Fiore’s brother, who wishes to protect her.

episodes.title: The Price of Life, the Redemption of Death

characters.name: Escaped homunculus
characters.description: Escapes with Astolfo but suffers a fatal injury. Siegfried gives his heart to save him.

characters.name: Sieg
characters.description: The escaped homunculus chooses a name honoring Siegfried. Jeanne helps him begin a free life.

characters.name: Jack the Ripper
characters.description: A Servant reported to have broken away from the Black faction in Sighisoara.

characters.name: Maomao
characters.description: A kidnapped apothecary working in the rear palace. Her knowledge of poisons helps her identify the cause of the infants’ illness.

characters.name: Jinshi
characters.description: The Inner Court’s manager, who identifies Maomao through a literacy test. His outward charm does not impress her.

characters.name: Gyokuyou
characters.description: A consort who follows the warning about cosmetics and credits Maomao with saving her daughter.

characters.name: Lihua
characters.description: A consort whose son falls ill. Her attendants fail to act on the warning left for them.

characters.name: Xiaolan
characters.description: A fellow servant who shares palace gossip with Maomao.

characters.name: Hongniang
characters.description: Gyokuyou’s head lady-in-waiting, who welcomes Maomao into the Jade Pavilion.

characters.name: Lingli
characters.description: Gyokuyou’s young daughter, who recovers after the dangerous cosmetics are removed.

characters.name: Maomao
characters.description: Gyokuyou’s new food taster, drawing on her apothecary experience. She concealed her skills to keep her kidnappers from profiting.

characters.name: Gaoshun
characters.description: Jinshi’s attendant, who reports incidents and escorts Maomao.

characters.name: Fuyou
characters.description: A concubine connected to rumors of a wandering spirit, whose situation Maomao investigates.

characters.name: Lihua
characters.description: Recovers under Maomao’s care after the harmful cosmetics and unsuitable treatment are addressed.

characters.name: Lishu
characters.description: A young consort whose reaction to mackerel is investigated by Maomao at the garden party.

episodes.title: The Secret of the Dragon Balls

characters.name: Goku
characters.description: A strong, sheltered boy raised by Grandpa Gohan. He joins Bulma’s search while keeping his grandfather’s Dragon Ball.

characters.name: Bulma
characters.description: A technologically resourceful traveler collecting Dragon Balls. She explains their wish-granting power to Goku.

characters.name: Grandpa Gohan
characters.description: Goku’s late adoptive grandfather, who raised and trained him.

characters.name: Emperor Pilaf
characters.description: Seeks all seven Dragon Balls so that he can wish for world domination.

characters.name: Shu
characters.description: One of Pilaf’s subordinates searching for Dragon Balls.

characters.name: Mai
characters.description: One of Pilaf’s subordinates, who explains why a single Dragon Ball is insufficient.

characters.name: Turtle
characters.description: A lost turtle whom Goku volunteers to carry back toward the sea.

characters.name: Master Roshi
characters.description: The Turtle Hermit, who rewards Goku for helping Turtle and gives Bulma a Dragon Ball.

characters.name: Oolong
characters.description: A shapeshifter terrorizing a village. His transformations last only five minutes.

characters.name: Oolong
characters.description: Travels with Bulma and Goku. His transformations cannot increase his strength.

characters.name: Yamcha
characters.description: A desert bandit who challenges Goku but loses his nerve around Bulma.

characters.name: Puar
characters.description: Yamcha’s shapeshifting companion, who previously attended school with Oolong.

episodes.title: Keep an Eye on the Dragon Balls

characters.name: Yamcha
characters.description: Offers the travelers a replacement car while secretly planning to track their search for the Dragon Balls.

episodes.title: I'm Luffy! The Man Who's Gonna Be King of the Pirates!

characters.name: Monkey D. Luffy
characters.description: An aspiring Pirate King whose body has rubber properties. He encourages Coby and defeats Alvida.

characters.name: Coby
characters.description: Forced to work aboard Alvida’s ship, he dreams of joining the Marines and gains courage from Luffy.

characters.name: Alvida
characters.description: A pirate captain who bullies Coby and confronts Luffy.
